shortfall_rule: Pay in deterministic roster order until treasury is exhausted; unpaid amounts are reported as arrears pressure but no debt owner is created unless a later contract explicitly creates one.
extra_income_rule: Contract shares, tournament prizes, gifts, trade profit and personal business income are separate conserved transfers into the same personal_cash balance.
stipend_rule: Faction membership normally provides food, housing, training and institutional support. This cash amount is a modest personal allowance, not a full labor wage; enterprise/professional earnings and contract shares are separate transfers.
